bounded_admission_interpretation.reason: A literal sequential exhaustion of each full138-contract expiry ladder would consume512 contracts before reaching eight expiries. To exercise the specified eight-expiry design within the same512-contract ceiling, the factory retains current contracts and expands near-spot strike ranks across selected expiries.
bounded_admission_interpretation.ordering: Current contracts first; then absolute log-moneyness, lower strike, expiry distance to hard cutoff (later expiry wins ties), and right.
bounded_admission_interpretation.audit: Each case stores the exact selected fixing set, rule name, excluded contracts and excluded expiry candidates. This is an explicitly narrowed synthetic action universe, not a claim that excluded contracts were infeasible.

accounting_scope.production: All materialized feasible production openings and history actions use the actual account engine. Infeasible openings return a typed rejection for separate feasibility accounting.
accounting_scope.research: The named call-only/q=0 diagnostic domain has explicitly unqualified modeled opening accounting and does not claim production campaign trajectory coverage.
accounting_scope.fixed_objective: H0 and original deadline/hard cutoff are never reset by generated adjustments. A new query at the generated present recomputes path-IV normalization while retaining the original trajectory law and ledger as evidence.

verification.cases: Eight-expiry512-contract surface, exact formula and ATM reconstruction, actual three-action fill/nonfill ledger, deterministic replay hash, earlier eligible fill for a closed observation, support rejection, and budget check before pricing.

mandatory_untouched_edge_design.partition: Entire families and reserved-expiry universes are validation-only; training, calibration and augmentation-seed eligibility are false.
mandatory_untouched_edge_design.narrow_and_tangent_construction: Actual two-unit butterfly opening followed by an actual one-unit partial close at the original unit debit, plus one dollar for the narrow family. The original target remains fixed. Exact Decimal terminal topology verifies a point contact or a two-cent-wide interval.
mandatory_untouched_edge_design.other_properties: Actual inverse-butterfly disjoint terminal tails; 60/120/300-second true remaining lifetime; actual expense budget10.01 with mandatory delivery10 and one remaining action.
mandatory_untouched_edge_design.qualification: Exact frozen design, ledger and edge-property evidence only. Numerical reference labels and surrogate qualification still require their independent gates.
